Yes. These features redefine Godot’s capabilities as a next-generation 3D engine. Implementing them in the core ensures:

Optimal performance via tight engine integration.

Consistent API and workflow across teams and projects.

Reduced friction for developers aiming for ambitious projects without relying on external, unoptimized add-ons.
answers.workaround: No. While partial systems can be implemented via scripts, fully integrating procedural worlds, AI animation, GPU physics, hybrid rendering, and live collaboration requires core engine-level support for performance, scalability, and usability.
